subject: GRB 260808B: NOT optical observations
body:
B. Schneider (LAM), L. Izzo (INAF/OACN and DARK/NBI), A. Saccardi (CEA/Irfu), G. Corcoran (UCD), D. B. Malesani (DAWN/NBI and Radboud), D. O’Neill (U. Birmingham), report on behalf of a larger collaboration:

We observed the field of GRB 260808B detected by SVOM/ECLAIRs (Bouchet et al., GCN  45316; see also Wang et al., GCN 45322), using the ALFOSC camera mounted on the Nordic Optical Telescope (NOT). We obtained 3x300 s exposures in the SDSS r-band and 5x200s in the SDSS z-band at mid time 2026 Aug 09.1158 UT (12.43 hr after the trigger).

In the stacked images, we clearly detect the optical afterglow (Turpin et al., GCN 45318; Li et al., GCN 45320; Adami et al., GCN 45323; Saccardi et al., GCN 45328). We measure a preliminary AB magnitude of r = 22.72 +/- 0.17 mag, and z = 22.19 +/- 0.24 mag, calibrated against nearby stars from the Pan-STARRS catalog, and not corrected for Galactic extinction.
